text: {"content":"The new exception lookup misses moved all-day and floating-time occurrences. Assigning nativeTime constructs a UTC date-time. getExceptionFor() uses the iCalendar string as its key. A stored all-day key such as 20261011 or a floating key such as 20261011T100000 does not match the constructed UTC key. The fallback searches by start time and can return another occurrence. The loader then reports occurrence-not-found.","codeSuggestion":"","assessment":"P2. Valid stored exceptions cannot load through this route or save through the edit workflow.","rationale":"CalRecurrenceInfo.sys.mjs:19-29 preserves date and floating-time key forms. getExceptionFor() uses that key directly. The loader does not restore the source date type or floating timezone before the lookup. The added Save tests cover UTC and named time zones, but omit these forms.","recommendation":"change","validation":"The Node check used the exact loader, CalDateTime, CalTimezone, CalDuration, CalRecurrenceDate, CalRecurrenceInfo, and Ical modules with event and calendar doubles. Moved all-day and floating-time exceptions returned occurrence-not-found. The UTC control loaded correctly. Restoring the date type and floating timezone found both stored exceptions.","appliedSummary":"","changeSummary":"Restore the source recurrence date type and floating timezone before exception lookup. Keep rejection of IDs outside the recurrence set. Add moved all-day and floating-time exception tests.","state":"ready","changeAccepted":false,"changeReverted":false,"changesAmended":false}
